question: 累计消费金额超过全平台用户平均累计消费2倍、且累计下单超过8笔的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名、累计金额、订单数与购买商品种数）
initial_sql: WITH user_stats AS ( SELECT u.id, u.username, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id ), platform_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM user_stats ) SELECT us.username, ROUND(us.total_spent, 2) AS total_spent, us.order_count, us.product_count FROM user_stats us, platform_avg pa WHERE us.total_spent > pa.avg_spent * 2 AND us.order_count > 8 ORDER BY us.total_spent DESC
regenerated_sql: WITH user_order_stats AS (SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id), user_product_stats AS (SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id), platform_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM user_order_stats) SELECT u.username, ROUND(uos.total_spent, 2) AS total_spent, uos.order_count, ups.product_count FROM user_order_stats uos JOIN users u ON u.id = uos.user_id JOIN user_product_stats ups ON ups.user_id = uos.user_id CROSS JOIN platform_avg pa WHERE uos.total_spent > pa.avg_spent * 2 AND uos.order_count > 8 ORDER BY uos.total_spent DESC
gold_sql: WITH user_orders AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id), user_sku AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id) SELECT u.username, ROUND(uo.spent, 2) AS total_spent, uo.orders, us.sku_cnt FROM user_orders uo JOIN user_sku us ON us.uid = uo.uid JOIN users u ON u.id = uo.uid WHERE uo.spent > 2 * (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM user_orders) AND uo.orders > 8 ORDER BY uo.spent DESC, u.id
